visual_inspection.method: Codex inspected all five saved PNGs through the local image viewer, including the isolated composition frame.
observed: Three literal UTF-8 text overlays are visible at top, center and bottom inside the composition.
The blue, outlined white and plain white text presets are visually distinguishable.
The horizontal source is contained inside a 9:16 frame with neutral empty areas and no stretching.
Desktop dark/light layouts retain player, timeline and text/audio panels.
Mobile 375/390 viewport captures show the panels stacked vertically; DOM measurements found no horizontal overflow.

resolved_driver_issues.issue: The paused property became true before asynchronous native pause dispatch was recorded.
resolved_driver_issues.resolution: Wait for a new native pause event as well as paused=true; no fabricated media event.

resolved_driver_issues.issue: An exact implicit label lookup failed for a visible select whose label includes option text.
resolved_driver_issues.resolution: Use its combobox role and the accessible label prefix; all selected values are checked again against the persisted snapshot. No application change.

qa_dependency_installation.sandbox_attempt: Failed with EAI_AGAIN resolving registry.npmjs.org; no product dependency changed.
qa_dependency_installation.approved_retry: Installed two packages in the temporary isolated QA directory; exit 0.

limitations: This gate proves source playback, CSS composition, MP3 import and v2 persistence; it does not prove an encoded preview or the audible mix yet.
No human manual listening, physical mobile device or other browser was tested.
125% source gain, music mixing, loop and fades were configured and persisted; their audible behavior requires the later FFmpeg gate.
Mobile responsiveness was checked with emulated viewports; no new physical touch interaction claim is made.
The synthetic project, immutable revisions and uploaded originals remain active for the next R04 gates.
